title: Bram and the Veil
author: Orsen Fairweather
blurb: Mara Thornbury, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
